$comment: Decision for every foreign key in the MJ core schema that references Entity.ID, applied by spDeleteEntityWithCoreDependencies (migrations/v6/V202610261530__v6.2.x__CodeGen_EntityField_Drift_Repairs.sql).
action: delete = delete the referencing rows; null = set the column (and any alsoNull columns) to NULL; block = leave the reference and let the proc refuse, naming it.
references lists the FKs into Entity. dependents lists FKs into tables whose rows the proc deletes, so those rows are cleared first.
Default: nullable -> null, NOT NULL -> delete. Entries whose reason explains a different choice are deliberate exceptions.
delete-entity-fk-coverage.test.ts fails when generated metadata gains an FK into Entity, or into a table the proc deletes from, that has no entry here.
